text.Central Station:
How to Play ==
When you play Central Station you put into play a base with a strength of 5 defense and you gain 2 Trade. If you have 3 of more bases in play (including this one) gain 4 authority and draw a card.
 Strategy ==
Avarage base which becomes better when you got more bases in your deck. Otherwise the special ability won't trigger often. They can bypass this base to attack other bases or HQ.
